name: dsh-instance
description: The built-in Fishball instance: runs Fishball in its own private DSH profile attached to the main DSH, and binds to dsh-connector through its contract.
//locale: The Plugins page card title (design §0.7): DSH reads meta.title from the exported ./locale/*.json without loading this package, and shows the package name when that file is absent. The instance has no host-DSH UI (R-ARCH-05): V3 R-EMBED moved its Plugins card, with ./client, to dsh-connector-ui; the status line it shows stays here, in src/child-settings/client.status.js.
//exports: ./status-line is the instance's status line (R-EMBED; HOST-EP-03 row 2: its one owner is src/child-settings/). It is a browser chunk, not a Node module: dsh-connector-ui's copy beside its client.js comes from this export (a symlink in the repository; the release packing task dereferences it, DESIGN.md §17).
//files: bundled/ holds the plugin set's sources in a packed instance (design §8.1); it is REL-PACK output, never committed (Q-22): in a checkout, placement reads the sibling workspace folders (src/native-runtime/placement.js). src/child-settings/ holds only that status line.
//TODO: SPLIT-SHARED (v3-remaining-plan §6): fishball-shared below becomes dsh-connector-shared (design §1.0c, §1.0b row 5). RENAME-DSH left it, as the split is that task's.
//dependencies: fishball-shared holds the modules the instance host shares with the Fishball side (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1). It is bundled, so the tarball carries it and an install fetches nothing from a registry; the version moves with this package's.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation (verified in spike S8). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate. dsh-connector is the connector this instance binds to: only its ./contract export is imported (design §0.2). The range is package versions (user decision 2026-11-07): from this release's 0.1.0-alpha.0 up to, not including, 2. The contract version is checked separately when the instance attaches (CONNECTOR_CONTRACT, major 1).
